entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought last month.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the RoadMaster cycling shoes, delivered on November 19th, which was 33 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, they're giving me painful blisters on my heels after about 10 miles. They're just not the right shape for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not what we want for our customers. Fit is so important with performance gear. Let me just pull up our policy for you.

Alright, I've checked our system, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return and get you a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you right now.

Okay, that's good news. I appreciate you approving the refund. Since I did go through the trouble of testing them and now have to pack them up and send them back, is there anything else you can do for me? Maybe a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable request. Let me see what's possible... I can see from your account that you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty and for the inconvenience, I can add a 20% discount coupon directly to your account. You can use it on any VeloFit gear, including a new pair of shoes. Would that work for you?
Yes, a 20% discount is perfect. That's very helpful. Thank you for sorting that out, Alex.

You're very welcome. The email with the return label should be in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
